description: Check whether 1 to 25 email addresses can receive mail. Each result has `status` (valid, invalid, catch-all or unknown), `reason`, `reason_text`, `score` (0 to 100), `recommendation` (send, send_with_caution, retry_later or do_not_send), `charged`, `flags`, `smtp_code`, `catch_all_tier`, `did_you_mean` (a likely domain typo), `mail_provider` and `checked_at`. Costs $0.003 per valid or invalid result, drawn from your balance; catch-all and unknown results are free (pricing_get lists which statuses are charged). When the balance covers only some addresses, the rest come back `unknown` with reason `not_checked_insufficient_credits`, free. `depth: "quick"` never contacts the mail server: syntax, disposable and free lists, DNS, parked and new-domain flags and a recently measured catch-all verdict, at $0.001 per address whatever the status; an address that needs a mailbox check comes back `unknown` with reason `not_probed`.

depth.description: full (default) checks the mailbox; quick is DNS and lists only, $0.001 per address.

emails.description: The addresses to check, 1 to 25 per call. An item may be {email, first_name, last_name} to also check the address against the person's name.

name: email_verify
title: Verify Email Addresses
